image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a black computer keyboard. The image focuses on the bottom row, prominently featuring an elongated rectangular key (the space bar) flanked by two smaller modifier keys. Above these are rows of standard square letter keys with white characters. The lighting creates soft highlights on the matte plastic surfaces.
